value.rationale: The order polynomial is a complete natural invariant for all maximal commutative subsemigroups of all finite Brandt inverse semigroups. It connects finite-group maximal-abelian subgroup sizes to a canonical semigroup structure, distinguishes inclusion-maximal and maximum-cardinality configurations and gives an infinite family of exact counts.
